native_extraction.script: See the complete reproduction recipe in docs/public-data.md.
native_extraction.time_warning: Default python-evtx uses float(FILETIME)*1e-7 and renders a space-separated datetime at microsecond precision. For record4807 it outputs 2019-03-17 19:37:11.661928+00:00, 2.4 microseconds earlier than raw FILETIME. The isolated script overrides only FiletimeTypeNode.string with integer divmod(ticks,10000000), retaining original 100ns ticks and emitting ISO UTC with 7 digits. No source field or event content is invented.
